senses.zh_definition: 长期受疾病折磨；久病不愈。
senses.en_definition: To suffer from a prolonged illness.
senses.nuances: 强调病痛持续，并非普通的短暂不适；不表示任何特定疾病。[释义依据：PRPM／Kamus Dewan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=202792&keyword=merana)。

collocations.en: to suffer from a prolonged illness
to suffer persistently because of illness

senses.zh_definition: 长期病弱，并逐渐消瘦、衰败的。
senses.en_definition: Persistently sickly and progressively wasting away.
senses.ms_definition: Sentiasa sakit-sakit dan makin lama makin kurus.
senses.nuances: 侧重身体持续衰弱的状态；单纯身材瘦并不等于 merana。

senses.zh_definition: 持续承受生活困苦、悲伤或情感折磨。
senses.en_definition: To endure continuing hardship, sorrow, or emotional suffering.
senses.ms_definition: Sentiasa menanggung kesusahan, kesedihan atau penderitaan.
senses.nuances: 常见于感情、离别与人生困境的叙述，语气比 susah 或 sedih 强，带有绵延不尽的痛苦感。

collocations.en: to lead a life of suffering

dual_scenarios.context: 新闻 / 社会援助报告
dual_scenarios.ms: Bantuan tersebut disalurkan kepada keluarga yang hidup merana akibat kehilangan sumber pendapatan.
dual_scenarios.zh: 该项援助发放给因失去收入来源而生活困苦的家庭。
dual_scenarios.en: The assistance was distributed to families enduring hardship after losing their source of income.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Sejak putus cinta, aku merana je kat rumah.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Sejak hubungan cinta itu berakhir, saya terus merana di rumah.
dual_scenarios.zh: 自从分手后，我就一直窝在家里难受。
dual_scenarios.en: Since the breakup, I’ve just been miserable at home.

je 对应 sahaja，此处突出持续处于同一种状态

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Aku tahu kau sedih. Kalau nak teman, aku boleh datang petang ni.
messages.ms_standard: Saya tahu awak sedih. Jika awak mahu ditemani, saya boleh datang pada petang ini.
messages.zh: 我知道你很难过。想找个人陪的话，我今天傍晚可以过去。
messages.en: I know you’re hurting. If you want some company, I can come over this evening.

etymology.historical_story: Malay literary culture gives merana a life beyond physical illness. PRPM records the titles Kaseh Merana from 1936 and Jiwa merana from 1948, alongside a pantun about an orphan’s suffering. These examples connect the word with love, loss, and loneliness. They document its cultural history without establishing a particular ancient borrowing route. [Source: PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=202792&keyword=merana).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 跟读 mə-ra-na，想象一句拖长的叹息：病痛拖着，心事拖着，人便一直受苦。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 描述他人的疾病或贫困时带有强烈悲情色彩，宜体谅当事人的感受；正式援助材料可用更具体的病况或生活困难描述。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适合文学、情感倾诉和长期困苦的叙述。朋友间可以夸张自嘲，但不宜用来轻视真实的疾病、丧亲或贫困。
